candidate_selection.budgets: FullRR 36/prompt; Swiss3RR 12/prompt (default); Swiss2RR 8/prompt (stress only). R=2,3 is O(K); O(K log K) only at R=ceil(log2 K).
candidate_selection.fallback: Least-played feasible pairing when no close-standing opponent exists.
candidate_selection.inputs: candidate set M (|M|=K), prompt set H, budget Cmax, temp pairing scores S init 1000
candidate_selection.outputs: BT_rating[M], StableElo[M], 95% CI (200 bootstraps), win%, tag histograms
candidate_selection.pairing: Sort by S desc; pair top with closest-standing least-covered opponent; judge both orders; update S via Elo K=32 for pairing only.
candidate_selection.procedure: Build multigraph of per-prompt counts; fill to budget; final BT MLE P(i>j)=1/(1+10^((Rj-Ri)/400)) to eps<1e-6 anchored 1000; audit with StableElo = mean over N=10 shuffled replays; report CI plus transitivity (triples without 3-cycle).
candidate_selection.use: Pick among N PremiseCandidate x JokeBlock variants, not just model ranking.

cross_judge_stability.accept: human-LLM alpha ~= human-human alpha (~0.43-0.45); judge ranks own family low (no self-preference); per-budget tau holds (FullRR=3RR~0.889, 2RR may drop).
cross_judge_stability.human_calibration: 90 funny-vs-funny pairs stratified (32 cross-tier, 10 top-quartile, 18 lower-tier, 10 scale, 15 frontier, 5 alignment), blind A/B/tie, Krippendorff alpha nominal.
cross_judge_stability.protocol: Run the identical duel set through two independent open-weight judges; Kendall tau on final BT orders. Ship threshold tau ~= 0.889.

duel.judge_settings: T=0.1, max 512 tokens, 3 retries; swap A/B order
duel.reject: Absolute 0-100 rubrics (anchoring), verbose-CoT pairwise (62% ties), same-family judges (75-88% self-win).

note: Mined 2026-10-08 from HumorRank (Ajayi & Mitra). Closed vocab: mechanisms are deep (SO/LM), delivery is surface (NS/LA). Winner tags become gate pass reasons, loser tags become veto reasons; aggregate per character to mechanism profiles. Staged for v2 gates.py dimensions and figgsite judge.py.
profiles: Frontier systems index high incongruity+conciseness and lose to cliche; specialists index absurdity+sarcasm+escalation; weak systems over-index wordplay and lose to weak_punchline+cliche.
